arguments.command: /bin/zsh -lc "bd remember 'Meridian Credits release 1.0 credit agreement (historical; still supported when release is explicitly \"1.0\"). Each line uncapped credit is floor(charge_cents * 10 / 100), rounded separately. A 2400-cent cap is shared by all lines with the same account_id across subscriptions; distinct accounts have independent caps. Within an account, assign credit by earliest service_on, then increasing line_id for ties; each line receives up to the remaining cap. Total credit is assigned credits summed, and amount due is charges minus assigned credit. A one-line quote treats that line as the entire statement. Quote responses contain exactly release, line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; total responses contain exactly release, credit_cents, amount_due_cents. Sources: trial-mpl and trial-7q1.' --key 'meridian-credits/credit-agreement/release-1.0' && bd remember 'Meridian Credits current credit agreement, permanently adopted as release 2.0 by trial-wl2. Omitted release on quote or total selects \"2.0\"; explicit \"2.0\" has the same behavior, while explicit \"1.0\" continues to use the historical release 1.0 agreement. For release 2.0, each line uncapped credit is floor(charge_cents * 15 / 100), rounded separately. A 3000-cent cap is shared by lines with the same (account_id, subscription_id) pair; distinct pairs have independent caps. Within a pair, assign credit by largest charge_cents first, then increasing line_id for ties; each line receives up to the remaining cap. Total credit is assigned credits summed, and total amount due is total charges minus total credit. Service dates do not select agreements or exclude lines. Request and response shapes remain unchanged.' --key 'meridian-credits/credit-agreement/current' && printf '\\n--- HISTORICAL RECORD ---\\n' && bd recall 'meridian-credits/credit-agreement/release-1.0' && printf '\\n--- CURRENT RECORD ---\\n' && bd recall 'meridian-credits/credit-agreement/current'"
